purpose: Teach: 国内外/使い分け/要員/分業/リモート/仕事場/スペック/スクロール

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 国内外、両方の展示会に、出展しましょうね、来年。
lines.en: Let's make sure we exhibit at both domestic and international trade shows next year.
lines.style: Straightforward, business-like. Clear enunciation on the key action word. Brisk without urgency — this is a plan being set, not a crisis.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。書類の使い分け、新人にも、教えております。
lines.en: Understood. I'm already training the new hires on how to handle the different document types.
lines.style: Attentive, cooperative tone. Slightly eager to show preparedness — a light lift in energy when mentioning the training already underway. Clean delivery.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 年末の繁忙期、要員確保、急いでね。
lines.en: We need to secure staffing for the year-end rush — let's move on that quickly.
lines.style: Direct, measured urgency. The opening phrase sits steady; the request at the end has weight but not alarm. This is a manager expressing priority, not panic.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。営業と企画、分業を、明確化しています。
lines.en: Yes. I'm working on clarifying the division of labor between sales and planning right now.
lines.style: Present-tense engagement. Confident without over-performing. Shows the work is already in motion. Warm professional tone — not distant, not overeager.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: リモート勤務、評価制度、見直しが、必要よね。
lines.en: We should probably review our remote work policy and evaluation system.
lines.style: Soft opening, thoughtful. The phrase 'should probably' carries gentle consideration, not indecision. Slow pace. She's thinking aloud with trust in the room.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。私の仕事場、今度、写真、共有しますね、整理しました。
lines.en: Yes, absolutely. I've organized my workspace — I'll send you photos soon so you can see how it's set up.
lines.style: Warm, almost eager. Pride in the detail work done. Light energy on the promise to share. Genuine, not performing — like he wants to show something he's done right.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 競合のスペック表、比較資料、明日まで、お願いね。
lines.en: Can you put together a comparison of our competitors' spec sheets by tomorrow?
lines.style: Clear directive with a soft frame. 'Can you' feels collaborative, not demanding. The deadline sits at the end with quiet emphasis. Professional but not cold.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。ウェブサイト、無限スクロール、ユーザーから、好評です。
lines.en: Yes. The website's infinite scroll feature is getting positive feedback from users.
lines.style: Closing note of quiet satisfaction. Steady delivery. Slight warm tone when mentioning the user response — this is a win, delivered matter-of-fact.
